answer.answer:
### Short answer
The passages do not rank “most important” automotive signaling test capabilities, but the supported automotive-focused capabilities are NG eCall over 4G/5G, hybrid eCall fallback, PSAP scenario testing, IMS voice/data and MSD transfer, GNSS positioning, voice/audio quality, real-world network scenario emulation, and related LTE/NR signaling/application test support.[16][22][32][86]
| Capability area | What the passages support for Automotive | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| NG eCall over 4G/5G IMS | CMX500 with CMX-KA098 is used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions, including voice and data transmission, PSAP simulation, and EN 17240:2024 validation context.[7] | [7] |
| EN 17240:2024 / EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 PSAP scenarios | CMX-KA098 completed PSAP test scenarios according to EN 17240:2024+A1:2026, and CMX500 with CMX-KA098 is tied to NGeCall over NR/LTE capability lists.[16][37] | [16][37] |
| Hybrid eCall fallback | Hybrid eCall testing covers NG eCall functions using IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G, with automatic fallback to classic CS eCall 2G/3G paths when coverage or service quality degrades.[22] | [22] |
| Call triggering, MSD, GNSS, voice quality | Manufacturers need to validate that hybrid implementations can trigger calls, transmit MSD, maintain GNSS positioning, and provide intelligible voice quality.[16][22] | [16][22] |
| VoNR, VoLTE, circuit-switched fallback, handover, degraded radio | Hybrid eCall test scenarios include VoNR, VoLTE, circuit-switched fallback, handovers, degraded radio conditions, real-world mobile network condition simulation, and various network scenario emulation.[86] | [86] |
| IMS eCall session establishment | CMX-KA098 test scope includes IMS eCall session establishment for automatic, manual, and test eCall.[32] | [32] |
| SIM/USIM, registration, limited service, eCall-only cases | CMX-KA098 test scope includes SIM/USIM conformance, network registration, limited service condition, and eCall-only IVS cases.[32] | [32] |
| MSD transfer and update | CMX-KA098 test scope includes MSD transfer, MSD update, negative AL-ACK, missing AL-ACK, and IPv4 / IPv6 MSD transfer.[32] | [32] |
| Voice link and audio interface | CMX-KA098 test scope includes voice link established, audio interface verification, and Time-Warping / No Time-Warping conformance tests.[32] | [32] |
| PSAP callback and clear-down behavior | CMX-KA098 test scope includes PSAP callback, clear-down, remain registered, and redial / no-redial cases.[32] | [32] |
| LTE/EPS and 5GS/NR eCall cases | CMX-KA098 test scope includes 5GS / NR eCall over IMS cases from 3GPP TS 34.229-5 and TS 38.523-1, and LTE / EPS eCall over IMS cases from 3GPP TS 34.229-1 and TS 36.523-1.[32] | [32] |
| Audio codecs and perceived speech quality | CMX500 application/audio options include CMX-KA180 for 4G/5G IMS voice call codecs AMR-NB, AMR-WB and EVS, CMX-KA181 for POLQA perceived speech quality, and CMX-KA401 for WAV player/recorder, file-based POLQA, and end-to-end audio delay.[5] | [5] |
| IP application and traffic analysis | CMX-KA100 provides internal IP services and IP connection testing including IMS, FTP, HTTP, iPerf, Ping, throughput and web server, while CMX-KA150 provides IP analysis for DUT uplink/downlink IP traffic.[5] | [5] |
| LTE/NR/WLAN signaling foundation | CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD device testing, and also provides NR/LTE/WLAN signaling, TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput and PER measurement.[6] | [6] |
| Automotive-grade modem verification context | Rohde & Schwarz and Qualcomm Technologies used CMX500 to verify NG eCall functionality on Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF, described as a 5G automotive-grade platform supporting high-speed connectivity, advanced positioning, V2X, multi-band GNSS navigation and enhanced safety.[13] | [13] |
### Product / option touchpoints
| Product / option | Supported automotive-related role | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 | Used as the mobile radio tester / radio communication tester basis for NG eCall and hybrid eCall test solutions.[7][16] | [7][16] |
| R&S CMX-KA098 | NGeCall / IMS eCall application test software option for CMX500, with capability lists for NGeCall over NR-LTE / LTE tests.[96] | [96] |
| R&S CMX-KF671B | Listed as CMX500 NGECALL E2E TEST SCRIPTS and mandatory for 4G/5G NG eCall 17240:2024 configuration.[89] | [89] |
| R&S CMX-KA099 | Completed PSAP test scenarios according to EN 18052:2025 and is positioned in the hybrid eCall / EN 18052 context.[36] | [36] |
| R&S CMX-KF672B | Listed as NGECALL TC EN18052 in the EN18052:2025 hybrid configuration.[88] | [88] |
| R&S SMBV100B | Used as the base unit for eCall GNSS receiver / performance test configuration.[30] | [30] |

- [[Communication of UAVs]] 已整理 UAV communication 的功能、鏈路、協定、硬體與頻段摘錄；本來源補充具體 UAV 產品例子與 [[R&S CMX500]] signaling test 配置線索。

- [[UAV 通訊]] — 本來源補充 UAV 產品使用 Radio、Wi‑Fi、LTE、5G、SATCOM、RTK 與 proprietary radio 的例子。

R&S CMX500 › 使用介面與 automation
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

| 介面 | 原文定位 |
|---|---|
| [[CMsquares]] | 單一 graphical user interface，web-based、responsive，支援 RF tests、functional tests、advanced signaling tests、protocol tests |

| [[R&S CMsequencer]] | Graphical scripting interface，可在 CMX500 或 Windows PC 上建立、設定與執行 test scripts |
| [[XLAPI]] | Python-based scripting interface，適合 complex scripting use cases |

XLAPI scripting environment：Python 3.10；script development computer 可為 Windows PC 或 CMX500；XLAPI installation package 為 **CMX-KF600X**。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。

- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 驗證範圍
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard]]：

- 驗證對象：[[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 的 [[Next Generation eCall]] functionality。
- 合作方：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]]。
- 測試設備：[[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester。
- Software context：來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] with [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option can be effectively used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions。
- 標準：[[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 測試情境：simulating a [[PSAP]]。
- 驗證內容：NG eCall including voice and data transmission，並 validated the compliance of the implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › Regulatory transition context
同一來源提供下列背景，但未列 regulation 文件編號：

- [[eCall]] automated vehicle emergency call system introduced in 2015。
- eCall 自 2018 年起是 all new cars sold within the European Union 的 mandatory requirement。
- 來源稱 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks become obsolete，因此 emergency call systems 需要 adapted to 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] most recent regulation 定義 NG eCall will be obligatory starting **2026-01-01**。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 establishes guidelines for testing eCall systems over [[IMS]] networks, including advanced 4G LTE and 5G NR technologies。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由新聞稿支撐，不是 EN 17240:2024 標準摘要、conformance test plan 或 certification report。
- 來源未列 test case IDs、test conditions、network parameters、IMS setup、GNSS setup、software versions 或 pass/fail details。
- 來源未說 whether verification equals formal certification；因此本頁使用 verification，不改寫為 certification。
- 來源未提供 European Commission regulation 的正式文件編號；2026-01-01 obligation date 只能追溯到本新聞稿說法。

EEI labeling test solution
[[EEI labeling test solution]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[SmartViser]] 在 PR 中描述的 joint solution，用於協助測試 smartphones 與 tablets 是否符合 EU [[Energy Efficiency Index labeling for smartphones and tablets]] 要求。

EEI labeling test solution › 使用限制
- 來源未列完整 bill of materials、CMX500 hardware configuration、software license、order number、power measurement accessory、SmartViser license 或 Android / iOS app version。
- 來源未提供 EEI Annex IV 的完整測試步驟與 calculation method。
- 來源未提供 accuracy、uncertainty、repeatability 數字或認證報告。
- 本頁不能用作報價或合規聲明；需回查正式 configuration guide、application note、regulation text 與 test lab guidance。

EEI labeling test solution › 與既有 CMX500 知識的關係
- [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 與 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 已確認 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 LTE、5G NR、WLAN、RF measurements、protocol / application testing 等能力。
- 本 PR 將這些能力連到 smartphone / tablet EEI compliance testing，但未提供新的 binding technical specifications。
- 因此本頁將該方案視為 solution-level / PR-level claim，而非正式 configuration 或規格表。

Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱其與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 合作，驗證 [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 上 [[Next Generation eCall]]（NG eCall）的 implementation，並稱其符合 [[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 來源說 [[eCall]] 於 2015 年導入，且自 2018 年起成為歐盟境內所有新車銷售的 mandatory requirement。
- 來源指出，隨著 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks 逐漸 obsolete，emergency call systems 需要適配到 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] 在其 most recent regulation 中定義 NG eCall 將自 **2026-01-01** 起成為 obligatory。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 建立在 IP Multimedia Subsystem（[[IMS]]）networks 上測試 eCall systems 的 guidelines，涵蓋 advanced 4G LTE 與 5G NR technologies。
- [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 被描述為 5G automotive-grade platform，支援 high-speed connectivity、advanced positioning、Vehicle-to-Everything（[[V2X]]）、multi-band [[GNSS]] navigation 與 enhanced safety。
- 來源稱驗證流程使用 [[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester，作為 NG eCall voice and data transmission 的 comprehensive testing solution。
- 來源稱測試模擬 [[PSAP]]，並驗證 implementation at both ends with the [[EN 17240]]:2024 standard。
- 來源說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 4G 與 5G technologies，目標是讓方案 future-proof。
- [[Juergen Meyer]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Vice President Market Segment Automotive 身分在新聞稿中引述，稱此次 collaboration 為 future emergency call services 建立 new benchmark。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option 可在 realistic network conditions 下用於 NG eCall testing。
- 來源將合作定位為 mutually validating solutions、reducing effort、accelerating time to market for mutual customers。
- Press and media contact 為 [[Patrizia Muehlbauer]]，職稱 PR Manager Products & Standard Systems。
- 公司資訊段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 2024/2025 fiscal year net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，2025-06-30 worldwide employees more than 15,000。

cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱其 hybrid eCall 與 Next Generation eCall test solution 已成功通過 [[cetecom advanced]] 的 certification testing。
- 來源描述 [[cetecom advanced]] 是 independent test laboratory，服務範圍包含 communication technologies、automotive、medical technology、payment & identification 等產品測試與 worldwide certification。
- 測試方案以 [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester 為基礎，搭配更新後的 eCall option，以支援最新 eCall regulations and standards。
- 來源說 [[Hybrid eCall testing]] 所依據的 [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system 結合不同 transmission paths and protocols，使 eCall 能可靠到達目的地。
- 來源說實務上車輛會使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G；但在 coverage 或 service quality 降低時，可自動 fallback 到 classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- 製造商需要驗證 hybrid implementations 能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並在 [[VoNR]]、[[VoLTE]] 與 circuit-switched fallback 等多種 network scenarios 下提供 intelligible voice quality。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱其 eCall evaluation solution [[R&S CMX-KA09x]] 已更新，以支援 compliance with [[EN 18052]]:2025 與 [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026。
- [[R&S CMX-KA099]] option completed Public Safety Answering Point scenario tests according to [[EN 18052]]:2025。
- [[R&S CMX-KA098]] option completed Public Safety Answering Point scenario tests according to [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026。
- [[Thomas Reschka]] 以 [[cetecom advanced]] Senior Technical Consultant 身分表示，該 solution 用於 functional tests、protocol conformity tests，以及 type-approval of [[IVS]] implementing hybrid eCall and NG eCall。
- 來源稱 test environment 可 simulation real-world mobile network conditions 並 emulation various network scenarios，用於 certifications 或 new vehicle model market launch 前準備。
- Press contact 為 [[Patrizia Muehlbauer]]，職稱 PR Manager Products & Standard Systems。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試目的
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]，hybrid eCall test specification [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system combine different transmission paths and protocols，確保 eCall reliably reaches its destination。

來源描述的實務語境：

- 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。
- 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 automatically fall back to available classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- Manufacturers 需要 validate hybrid implementations，以確保能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並提供 intelligible voice quality。

Hybrid eCall testing › R&S solution context
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]：

- 測試方案基於 [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester。
- [[R&S CMX-KA09x]] updated eCall evaluation solution 支援 [[EN 18052]]:2025 與 [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026 compliance。
- [[R&S CMX-KA099]] completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios according to [[EN 18052]]:2025。
- [[R&S CMX-KA098]] completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios according to [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026。
- [[cetecom advanced]] conducted certification testing。

R&S CMX-KA098 › 功能與測試範圍摘錄

- IMS eCall session establishment，包含 automatic、manual 與 test eCall。
- SIM/USIM conformance、network registration、limited service condition、eCall-only IVS cases。
- MSD transfer、MSD update、negative AL-ACK、missing AL-ACK、IPv4 / IPv6 MSD transfer。
- Voice link established、audio interface verification、Time-Warping / No Time-Warping conformance test。
- PSAP callback、clear-down、remain registered、redial / no-redial cases。
- 5GS / NR 相關 eCall over IMS cases，由 [[3GPP TS 34.229-5]] 與 [[3GPP TS 38.523-1]] 區段支撐。
- LTE / EPS 相關 eCall over IMS cases，由 [[3GPP TS 34.229-1]] 與 [[3GPP TS 36.523-1]] 區段支撐。

Virtual Signalling Tester › 來源定義
[[mx844030pc-j1200]] 將 [[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 描述為 software protocol simulator / Virtual Signalling Test Solution，透過虛擬化 protocol stack，在 PC 上重現多個 protocol layers：

- [[RRC-NAS]]
- [[PDCP]]

### Short answer
The passages do not rank “most important” automotive signaling test capabilities, but the supported automotive-focused capabilities are NG eCall over 4G/5G, hybrid eCall fallback, PSAP scenario testing, IMS voice/data and MSD transfer, GNSS positioning, voice/audio quality, real-world network scenario emulation, and related LTE/NR signaling/application test support.[16][22][32][86]
| Capability area | What the passages support for Automotive | Evidence |

| Call triggering, MSD, GNSS, voice quality | Manufacturers need to validate that hybrid implementations can trigger calls, transmit MSD, maintain GNSS positioning, and provide intelligible voice quality.[16][22] | [16][22] |
| VoNR, VoLTE, circuit-switched fallback, handover, degraded radio | Hybrid eCall test scenarios include VoNR, VoLTE, circuit-switched fallback, handovers, degraded radio conditions, real-world mobile network condition simulation, and various network scenario emulation.[86] | [86] |
| IMS eCall session establishment | CMX-KA098 test scope includes IMS eCall session establishment for automatic, manual, and test eCall.[32] | [32] |
| SIM/USIM, registration, limited service, eCall-only cases | CMX-KA098 test scope includes SIM/USIM conformance, network registration, limited service condition, and eCall-only IVS cases.[32] | [32] |

| Voice link and audio interface | CMX-KA098 test scope includes voice link established, audio interface verification, and Time-Warping / No Time-Warping conformance tests.[32] | [32] |
| PSAP callback and clear-down behavior | CMX-KA098 test scope includes PSAP callback, clear-down, remain registered, and redial / no-redial cases.[32] | [32] |
| LTE/EPS and 5GS/NR eCall cases | CMX-KA098 test scope includes 5GS / NR eCall over IMS cases from 3GPP TS 34.229-5 and TS 38.523-1, and LTE / EPS eCall over IMS cases from 3GPP TS 34.229-1 and TS 36.523-1.[32] | [32] |

| Automotive-grade modem verification context | Rohde & Schwarz and Qualcomm Technologies used CMX500 to verify NG eCall functionality on Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF, described as a 5G automotive-grade platform supporting high-speed connectivity, advanced positioning, V2X, multi-band GNSS navigation and enhanced safety.[13] | [13] |

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 驗證範圍
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard]]：

- 驗證對象：[[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 的 [[Next Generation eCall]] functionality。
- 合作方：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]]。
- 測試設備：[[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester。
- Software context：來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] with [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option can be effectively used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions。
- 標準：[[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 測試情境：simulating a [[PSAP]]。
- 驗證內容：NG eCall including voice and data transmission，並 validated the compliance of the implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024。

Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱其與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 合作，驗證 [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 上 [[Next Generation eCall]]（NG eCall）的 implementation，並稱其符合 [[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 來源說 [[eCall]] 於 2015 年導入，且自 2018 年起成為歐盟境內所有新車銷售的 mandatory requirement。
- 來源指出，隨著 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks 逐漸 obsolete，emergency call systems 需要適配到 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] 在其 most recent regulation 中定義 NG eCall 將自 **2026-01-01** 起成為 obligatory。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 建立在 IP Multimedia Subsystem（[[IMS]]）networks 上測試 eCall systems 的 guidelines，涵蓋 advanced 4G LTE 與 5G NR technologies。
- [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 被描述為 5G automotive-grade platform，支援 high-speed connectivity、advanced positioning、Vehicle-to-Everything（[[V2X]]）、multi-band [[GNSS]] navigation 與 enhanced safety。
- 來源稱驗證流程使用 [[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester，作為 NG eCall voice and data transmission 的 comprehensive testing solution。
- 來源稱測試模擬 [[PSAP]]，並驗證 implementation at both ends with the [[EN 17240]]:2024 standard。
- 來源說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 4G 與 5G technologies，目標是讓方案 future-proof。
- [[Juergen Meyer]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Vice President Market Segment Automotive 身分在新聞稿中引述，稱此次 collaboration 為 future emergency call services 建立 new benchmark。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option 可在 realistic network conditions 下用於 NG eCall testing。
- 來源將合作定位為 mutually validating solutions、reducing effort、accelerating time to market for mutual customers。
- Press and media contact 為 [[Patrizia Muehlbauer]]，職稱 PR Manager Products & Standard Systems。
- 公司資訊段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 2024/2025 fiscal year net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，2025-06-30 worldwide employees more than 15,000。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試目的
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]，hybrid eCall test specification [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system combine different transmission paths and protocols，確保 eCall reliably reaches its destination。

來源描述的實務語境：

- 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。
- 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 automatically fall back to available classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- Manufacturers 需要 validate hybrid implementations，以確保能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並提供 intelligible voice quality。

eCall GNSS Testing configuration
eCall GNSS Testing configuration 是 [[CMX_Configuration_Guide]] 中以 [[R&S SMBV100B]] vector signal generator 為主體的 eCall GNSS receiver / performance test configuration。

R&S CMX-KA098 › 功能與測試範圍摘錄
CMX-KA098 在來源中的測試範圍包含：

- IMS eCall session establishment，包含 automatic、manual 與 test eCall。
- SIM/USIM conformance、network registration、limited service condition、eCall-only IVS cases。
- MSD transfer、MSD update、negative AL-ACK、missing AL-ACK、IPv4 / IPv6 MSD transfer。
- Voice link established、audio interface verification、Time-Warping / No Time-Warping conformance test。
- PSAP callback、clear-down、remain registered、redial / no-redial cases。
- 5GS / NR 相關 eCall over IMS cases，由 [[3GPP TS 34.229-5]] 與 [[3GPP TS 38.523-1]] 區段支撐。
- LTE / EPS 相關 eCall over IMS cases，由 [[3GPP TS 34.229-1]] 與 [[3GPP TS 36.523-1]] 區段支撐。

- [[R&S CMX-KA099]] option successfully completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios in accordance with [[EN 18052]]:2025。
- certification testing was conducted by [[cetecom advanced]]。
- solution is based on [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester with updated eCall option。

- 多個測試不是單靠 [[R&S CMW-KA096]]、[[R&S CMWrun KT111]]、[[R&S CMX-KA098]] 或 [[R&S CMX-KF671B]] 即可完整自動化，因為需要 HMI interaction、engine / ignition OFF 控制、AT command、IVS debugging tool、Prepared TestUSIM、handset、crash simulation、in-band modem over IP support 或 IVS SUT IP address check。
- CMW500 / CMW-KA096 來源中，CTP 1.1.10.1-IMS limited service condition 標示 Partly Available，需 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，且 attach reject by network not supported yet。
- CMX500 / CMX-KA098 來源中，CEN EN 17240:2024 limited service tests 說明有兩種方式：使用 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，或 rejecting normal attach reject but accepting emergency attach；後者 currently not supported。
- CMW500 / CMW-KA096 來源中，CTP 1.1.17.2-IMS callback abnormal termination 標示 Not available。
- 3GPP TS 34.229-1 21.3 在既有 CMW500 來源中標示 Not available；CMX500 來源中 34.229-1 區段也可辨識 Not Available 標註。
- 兩份來源都保留 legacy CS domain eCall with inband-modem 到 NGeCall over IMS 的 transition 尚未由 EU commission 最終決定，因此部分 handover test cases 尚未實作的限制。

NGeCall over LTE
NGeCall over LTE 是以 LTE / IMS 承載 next generation eCall 的測試主題；在 [[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 中，它由 [[R&S CMW500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMW-KA096]] 或 [[R&S CMWrun KT111]] 對照多個 eCall / IVS 標準的測試支援狀態。[[CMX-KA098_CMX-KF671B_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 進一步把同一測試主題擴展到 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMX-KA098]] / [[R&S CMX-KF671B]] 的 NGeCall over NR/LTE capability list。

NGeCall over LTE › unresolved
- [[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 未標示文件版次，只有 Oct. 2024 的狀態標示。
- [[CMX-KA098_CMX-KF671B_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 未標示文件版次，且多個區段日期並存。
- 兩份來源皆為 lossy derivative，部分表格欄位不完整；每個 test case 的 exact availability 需回原始 PDF / Excel 核對。
- [[CMX-KA098_CMX-KF671B_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 標題聚焦 [[R&S CMX-KA098]]，但正文仍寫 CMW-KA09x test software；需回原始文件確認。
- [[CMX-KA098_CMX-KF671B_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 中 `CEN EN 17420:2024` 疑似 OCR / 原文錯字；尚未裁決。
- 來源未列 EU commission 對 legacy eCall / NGeCall transition 的決策日期或後續更新計畫。
- 來源未完整定義 [[IVS]]、[[PSAP]]、[[MSD]]、[[VoIMS]]、[[SRVCC]] 等縮寫；本頁不自行補定義。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試目的
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]，hybrid eCall test specification [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system combine different transmission paths and protocols，確保 eCall reliably reaches its destination。

來源描述的實務語境：

- 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。
- 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 automatically fall back to available classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- Manufacturers 需要 validate hybrid implementations，以確保能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並提供 intelligible voice quality。

Hybrid eCall testing › R&S solution context
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]：

- 測試方案基於 [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester。
- [[R&S CMX-KA09x]] updated eCall evaluation solution 支援 [[EN 18052]]:2025 與 [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026 compliance。
- [[R&S CMX-KA099]] completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios according to [[EN 18052]]:2025。
- [[R&S CMX-KA098]] completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios according to [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026。
- [[cetecom advanced]] conducted certification testing。

Hybrid eCall testing › unresolved
- [[EN 18052]] 的完整標準標題、發布組織與正式版本細節尚未由本來源提供。
- [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026 的 amendment A1 細節與發布狀態尚未由本來源提供。
- completed PSAP test scenarios 的 coverage、test IDs、結果細節與 certification scope 未標示。
- 來源未提供 degraded radio conditions、handover 與 voice quality 測試的具體設定。

CMX500 NGeCall configuration
CMX500 NGeCall configuration 是 [[CMX_Configuration_Guide]] 中針對 [[R&S CMX500]] 執行 4G/5G [[NGeCall over LTE]] / [[NGeCall over NR-LTE]]、PCT NGeCall 與 EN18052:2025 hybrid eCall 測試所列的 application-specific configuration。

CMX500 NGeCall configuration › eCall ITU-P1140 audio testing

來源明示 requires HEAD acoustics labCore system，更多資訊需聯絡 HEAD acoustics。

CMX500 NGeCall configuration › 使用限制
- 本頁只記錄 [[CMX_Configuration_Guide]] 中的 configuration table，不取代 [[R&S CMX500]] formal specifications、[[CMX-KA098_CMX-KF671B_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] capability list 或正式 quote / configurator output。

eCall GNSS Testing configuration › 使用限制
- [[CMX_Configuration_Guide]] 是 configuration guide，不是 [[R&S SMBV100B]] technical specifications。

- 來源未提供 eCall GNSS test suite 規格、GNSS scenario details、測試標準版本或完整 dependency tree。

eCall GNSS Testing configuration › 與正式 SMBV100B specs 的關係
[[R&S SMBV100B]] 既有頁面依 [[SMBV100B_specs_en_3607-8201-22_v1301]]（Specifications Version 13.01，August 2025）整理產品規格；本頁只整理 [[CMX_Configuration_Guide]] 的 eCall GNSS application configuration。

eCall GNSS Testing configuration

R&S CMX-KA098 › 使用限制
- 本頁只記錄來源明示的 license swap mapping、capability listing 與 software maintenance PU mapping。

R&S CMX-KA098 › 功能與測試範圍摘錄
CMX-KA098 在來源中的測試範圍包含：

- IMS eCall session establishment，包含 automatic、manual 與 test eCall。
- SIM/USIM conformance、network registration、limited service condition、eCall-only IVS cases。
- MSD transfer、MSD update、negative AL-ACK、missing AL-ACK、IPv4 / IPv6 MSD transfer。
- Voice link established、audio interface verification、Time-Warping / No Time-Warping conformance test。
- PSAP callback、clear-down、remain registered、redial / no-redial cases。
- 5GS / NR 相關 eCall over IMS cases，由 [[3GPP TS 34.229-5]] 與 [[3GPP TS 38.523-1]] 區段支撐。

Virtual Signalling Tester › 來源定義
[[mx844030pc-j1200]] 將 [[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 描述為 software protocol simulator / Virtual Signalling Test Solution，透過虛擬化 protocol stack，在 PC 上重現多個 protocol layers：

- [[RRC-NAS]]
- [[PDCP]]
- [[RLC]]
- [[MAC]]

來源主張它可不使用一般硬體測試儀而在 PC 上快速建立 protocol test environment；但 RF-IF configuration 仍使用 [[Anritsu MD8190A]] Universal RF Unit 與 [[MX819020A]] RF Platform。

Virtual Signalling Tester › Post-silicon testing
- 適用 [[IoT]] device 與 communication module 的 basic protocol test。
- 支援快速 functional test、regression test、sample scenario parameterization、test procedure 與 report / log display。
- 來源列出 [[5G RedCap]]、Automotive、Healthcare、Industrial IoT、Smart Cities 等應用語境。

Virtual Signalling Tester › 與 Virtual tester 的區分
[[Virtual tester]] 在 [[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 中是 R&S AI Workplace questionnaire 的 agentic workflow concept，跨 implementation、test、debug、validation。

[[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 則是 [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 中 Anritsu NR / RedCap protocol simulation and test product / solution 語彙。兩者名稱相近，但目前沒有來源支持它們是同一產品、同一架構或同一市場分類。

- [[CMX_Configuration_Guide]]、[[CMX_Configuration_Guide_LTE-DTC]] 與 [[CMX_Configuration_Guide_NR-NTN]] 都是 configuration guide，不是 technical specifications data sheet；material number、option code 與 mandatory / optional / recommended / conditional 註記可用於配置脈絡，但規格數字仍應回各產品正式 specs。
- 來源為 lossy derivative；欄位中的 NaN、空白、箭頭與換行可能源自 Excel 轉換。
- `mandatory`、`optional`、`recommended`、`conditional` 與 `not mandatory` 的含義依 application / test case 而定；不可轉用到所有 CMX500 或 CMW500 configurations。
- [[CMX_Configuration_Guide_LTE-DTC]] 中的 Starlink LTE-DTC scope 不可推論為 Starlink 官方認證、商業合作、產品供應關係或完整 test coverage。
- [[CMX_Configuration_Guide_NR-NTN]] 中的 NR-NTN scope 不可推論為所有 orbit、payload、bands、satellite operator、gateway interface 或 3GPP conformance coverage 皆已正式支援；需回正式 features / specifications / release notes 查證。
- 配置表未提供價格、正式 quote、configurator rules 或 commercial availability。

CMX configuration guide › eCall / NGeCall
[[CMX_Configuration_Guide]] 將 eCall / NGeCall 配置分成多段：

- [[R&S CMW500]] eCall 2G/3G（16454:2023）與 4G（2018）。
- CMWPC / [[R&S CMW-KA096]] / [[R&S CMWrun KT111]]。
- [[R&S CMX500]] NGeCall 4G/5G。
- [[R&S CMX500]] PCT NGeCall。

詳細見 [[CMX500 NGeCall configuration]] 與 [[eCall GNSS Testing configuration]]。

WLAN（CMX500）區段列出 WLAN signaling、measurement 與 ARB generator options，包含 [[R&S CMX-KS350B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS351B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS352B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS355B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS356B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS360B]]、[[R&S CMX-KM350]]、[[R&S CMX-KM351]]、[[R&S CMX-KM352]]、[[R&S CMX-KM360]]、[[R&S CMX-KW350]]、[[R&S CMX-KW351]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KW352]]。

### Short answer
The passages do not rank “most important” automotive signaling test capabilities, but the supported automotive-focused capabilities are NG eCall over 4G/5G, hybrid eCall fallback, PSAP scenario testing, IMS voice/data and MSD transfer, GNSS positioning, voice/audio quality, real-world network scenario emulation, and related LTE/NR signaling/application test support.[16][22][32][86]
| Capability area | What the passages support for Automotive | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| NG eCall over 4G/5G IMS | CMX500 with CMX-KA098 is used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions, including voice and data transmission, PSAP simulation, and EN 17240:2024 validation context.[7] | [7] |
| EN 17240:2024 / EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 PSAP scenarios | CMX-KA098 completed PSAP test scenarios according to EN 17240:2024+A1:2026, and CMX500 with CMX-KA098 is tied to NGeCall over NR/LTE capability lists.[16][37] | [16][37] |
| Hybrid eCall fallback | Hybrid eCall testing covers NG eCall functions using IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G, with automatic fallback to classic CS eCall 2G/3G paths when coverage or service quality degrades.[22] | [22] |
| Call triggering, MSD, GNSS, voice quality | Manufacturers need to validate that hybrid implementations can trigger calls, transmit MSD, maintain GNSS positioning, and provide intelligible voice quality.[16][22] | [16][22] |
| VoNR, VoLTE, circuit-switched fallback, handover, degraded radio | Hybrid eCall test scenarios include VoNR, VoLTE, circuit-switched fallback, handovers, degraded radio conditions, real-world mobile network condition simulation, and various network scenario emulation.[86] | [86] |
| IMS eCall session establishment | CMX-KA098 test scope includes IMS eCall session establishment for automatic, manual, and test eCall.[32] | [32] |
| SIM/USIM, registration, limited service, eCall-only cases | CMX-KA098 test scope includes SIM/USIM conformance, network registration, limited service condition, and eCall-only IVS cases.[32] | [32] |
| MSD transfer and update | CMX-KA098 test scope includes MSD transfer, MSD update, negative AL-ACK, missing AL-ACK, and IPv4 / IPv6 MSD transfer.[32] | [32] |
| Voice link and audio interface | CMX-KA098 test scope includes voice link established, audio interface verification, and Time-Warping / No Time-Warping conformance tests.[32] | [32] |
| PSAP callback and clear-down behavior | CMX-KA098 test scope includes PSAP callback, clear-down, remain registered, and redial / no-redial cases.[32] | [32] |
| LTE/EPS and 5GS/NR eCall cases | CMX-KA098 test scope includes 5GS / NR eCall over IMS cases from 3GPP TS 34.229-5 and TS 38.523-1, and LTE / EPS eCall over IMS cases from 3GPP TS 34.229-1 and TS 36.523-1.[32] | [32] |
| Audio codecs and perceived speech quality | CMX500 application/audio options include CMX-KA180 for 4G/5G IMS voice call codecs AMR-NB, AMR-WB and EVS, CMX-KA181 for POLQA perceived speech quality, and CMX-KA401 for WAV player/recorder, file-based POLQA, and end-to-end audio delay.[5] | [5] |
| IP application and traffic analysis | CMX-KA100 provides internal IP services and IP connection testing including IMS, FTP, HTTP, iPerf, Ping, throughput and web server, while CMX-KA150 provides IP analysis for DUT uplink/downlink IP traffic.[5] | [5] |
| LTE/NR/WLAN signaling foundation | CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD device testing, and also provides NR/LTE/WLAN signaling, TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput and PER measurement.[6] | [6] |
| Automotive-grade modem verification context | Rohde & Schwarz and Qualcomm Technologies used CMX500 to verify NG eCall functionality on Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF, described as a 5G automotive-grade platform supporting high-speed connectivity, advanced positioning, V2X, multi-band GNSS navigation and enhanced safety.[13] | [13] |

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 驗證範圍
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard]]：

- 驗證對象：[[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 的 [[Next Generation eCall]] functionality。
- 合作方：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]]。
- 測試設備：[[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester。
- Software context：來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] with [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option can be effectively used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions。
- 標準：[[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 測試情境：simulating a [[PSAP]]。
- 驗證內容：NG eCall including voice and data transmission，並 validated the compliance of the implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024。

Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱其與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 合作，驗證 [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 上 [[Next Generation eCall]]（NG eCall）的 implementation，並稱其符合 [[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 來源說 [[eCall]] 於 2015 年導入，且自 2018 年起成為歐盟境內所有新車銷售的 mandatory requirement。
- 來源指出，隨著 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks 逐漸 obsolete，emergency call systems 需要適配到 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] 在其 most recent regulation 中定義 NG eCall 將自 **2026-01-01** 起成為 obligatory。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 建立在 IP Multimedia Subsystem（[[IMS]]）networks 上測試 eCall systems 的 guidelines，涵蓋 advanced 4G LTE 與 5G NR technologies。
- [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 被描述為 5G automotive-grade platform，支援 high-speed connectivity、advanced positioning、Vehicle-to-Everything（[[V2X]]）、multi-band [[GNSS]] navigation 與 enhanced safety。
- 來源稱驗證流程使用 [[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester，作為 NG eCall voice and data transmission 的 comprehensive testing solution。
- 來源稱測試模擬 [[PSAP]]，並驗證 implementation at both ends with the [[EN 17240]]:2024 standard。
- 來源說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 4G 與 5G technologies，目標是讓方案 future-proof。
- [[Juergen Meyer]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Vice President Market Segment Automotive 身分在新聞稿中引述，稱此次 collaboration 為 future emergency call services 建立 new benchmark。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option 可在 realistic network conditions 下用於 NG eCall testing。
- 來源將合作定位為 mutually validating solutions、reducing effort、accelerating time to market for mutual customers。
- Press and media contact 為 [[Patrizia Muehlbauer]]，職稱 PR Manager Products & Standard Systems。
- 公司資訊段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 2024/2025 fiscal year net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，2025-06-30 worldwide employees more than 15,000。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試目的
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]，hybrid eCall test specification [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system combine different transmission paths and protocols，確保 eCall reliably reaches its destination。

來源描述的實務語境：

- 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。
- 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 automatically fall back to available classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- Manufacturers 需要 validate hybrid implementations，以確保能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並提供 intelligible voice quality。

eCall GNSS Testing configuration
eCall GNSS Testing configuration 是 [[CMX_Configuration_Guide]] 中以 [[R&S SMBV100B]] vector signal generator 為主體的 eCall GNSS receiver / performance test configuration。

R&S CMX-KA098 › 功能與測試範圍摘錄
CMX-KA098 在來源中的測試範圍包含：

- IMS eCall session establishment，包含 automatic、manual 與 test eCall。
- SIM/USIM conformance、network registration、limited service condition、eCall-only IVS cases。
- MSD transfer、MSD update、negative AL-ACK、missing AL-ACK、IPv4 / IPv6 MSD transfer。
- Voice link established、audio interface verification、Time-Warping / No Time-Warping conformance test。
- PSAP callback、clear-down、remain registered、redial / no-redial cases。
- 5GS / NR 相關 eCall over IMS cases，由 [[3GPP TS 34.229-5]] 與 [[3GPP TS 38.523-1]] 區段支撐。
- LTE / EPS 相關 eCall over IMS cases，由 [[3GPP TS 34.229-1]] 與 [[3GPP TS 36.523-1]] 區段支撐。

R&S CMX-KA099 › certification / PSAP scenario context
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]：

- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] updated its eCall evaluation solution [[R&S CMX-KA09x]] to support compliance with [[EN 18052]]:2025 and [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026。
- [[R&S CMX-KA099]] option successfully completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios in accordance with [[EN 18052]]:2025。
- certification testing was conducted by [[cetecom advanced]]。
- solution is based on [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester with updated eCall option。

這補充了 [[CMX_Configuration_Guide]] 的 configuration-table 視角，但新聞稿未提供 CMX-KA099 的 complete test case list、software version、license dependency、certificate number 或 formal datasheet。

R&S CMX-KA09x › 與已知 KA098 / KA099 的關係
[[R&S CMX-KA09x]] 在本來源中是 family / umbrella-like wording；它至少涵蓋或指向下列 option：

|---|---|---|
| [[R&S CMX-KA098]] | completed PSAP test scenarios according to [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026 | [[R&S CMX-KA098]] |
| [[R&S CMX-KA099]] | completed PSAP test scenarios according to [[EN 18052]]:2025 | [[R&S CMX-KA099]] |

既有 [[CMX-KA098_CMX-KF671B_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 已以 capability list 形式記錄 [[R&S CMX-KA098]] 的 NGeCall over NR/LTE 測試範圍；既有 [[CMX_Configuration_Guide]] 則將 [[R&S CMX-KA099]] 列為 [[CMX500 NGeCall configuration]] 中 EN18052:2025 hybrid configuration 的 mandatory software item。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試情境
來源明示或列出的 network scenarios 包含：

- [[VoNR]]。
- [[VoLTE]]。
- circuit-switched fallback。
- handovers。
- degraded radio conditions。
- real-world mobile network conditions simulation。
- various network scenarios emulation。

來源沒有提供各 scenario 的 test case IDs、channel model、radio profile 或 pass/fail criteria。
